facts: The method section follows the workbench and contains an h2 followed by .method-content.
The heading contains an explicit br between 'The model.' and 'Its limits.' at every breakpoint.
Content order is lead paragraph, explanatory paragraph, three native details/summary disclosures, then the code link.
None of the method details has an authored open attribute; initially closed content expands in normal document flow when opened.
No authored CSS order, absolute positioning or sticky positioning changes method content order.

source_observations.topic: Method grid breakpoints and container geometry
facts: Main is a centered border-box container capped at 1600px, including horizontal padding.
The shared grid uses minmax(0, 1fr); the method heading and content do not require implicit columns at the inspected breakpoint configurations.
Above 1199 CSS px: 12 tracks, 24px gaps, 4vw side padding, heading spans six tracks and content occupies tracks eight through twelve.
Above 767 through 1199 CSS px: eight tracks, 20px gaps, 3vw side padding, heading spans four tracks and content occupies tracks five through eight.
At or below 767 CSS px: four tracks, 16px gaps, 20px side padding; heading and content each occupy 1 / -1 and therefore successive rows.
The 1440px minimum-width media query changes the opening h1 only; it does not change the method section.
The method content has max-width: 75ch, so grid allocation does not imply that its used width always fills its grid area.
source_observations.calculation_limit: Algebra from authored CSS, assuming viewport width equals the main containing width and no scrollbar deduction. These are allocations, not browser measurements or text measures.

facts: Method section padding is 80px top / 110px bottom, changing to 50px / 64px on phone, with a 1px top border.
Lead bottom margin is 18px; the following top-level paragraph has a 28px bottom margin; disclosure paragraphs have an 18px bottom margin; the terminal link has a 24px top margin.
On phone the h2 adds an 18px bottom margin to the 16px grid row gap: 34px authored separation from the heading border box to the following content row, before text line-box considerations.
Summary is flex with a 10px gap, 16px vertical padding and min-height: 64px. Its chevron cannot flex-shrink and receives margin-left: auto.
Summary height is a minimum, not a fixed height; wrapped text can increase it. No local max-height or overflow clipping is applied to method disclosures.

source_observations.topic: File entry grid and breakpoint behavior
facts: The file drawer has three sections in DOM order: floorplan, 3D scene, experiment.
Above 767 CSS px the file grid remains three equal minmax(0, 1fr) columns with 36px gaps; it has no separate tablet column override.
At 768px, the authored main inner allocation of 721.92px gives each file section approximately 216.64px: (721.92 - 72) / 3.
At or below 767px it becomes one column with a 28px gap; every section after the first gains a 1px top border and 24px top padding.
File sections explicitly have min-width: 0. The outer drawer has borders and no local width, max-height or overflow restriction.
The drawer summary wraps on phone; its explanatory span moves to a full-width line via flex-basis: 100% and order: 2. This affects the description placement, not the order of the three file sections.

source_observations.topic: File entry spacing, conditional controls and intrinsic heights
facts: File grid padding is 12px top / 36px bottom. Each descriptive paragraph has margins 8px top / 20px bottom.
File sections use ordinary flow rather than a shared row layout. There is no authored mechanism aligning the three primary actions to one baseline.
The 3D section adds Numeric before its choose button. Numeric has a minimum 48px label area, 6px gap and minimum 44px input, giving a minimum 98px control stack before its 14px bottom margin.
The numeric field is capped at 200px; its input uses width: 100% and min-width: 0. A validation error adds content rather than using a fixed-height slot.
Primary choose/load buttons have min-height: 44px with 9px / 14px padding. File removal actions use display: flex and 8px vertical padding; the sample link uses display: flex and min-height: 44px.

No explicit sibling margin or gap separates a choose/load button from the following removal action or sample link. Their actual line-box separation is browser-dependent because the first button is inline-flex.
Conditional removal controls add normal-flow height without overlays. Hidden file inputs do not reserve a visible file-picker box.

source_observations.topic: Authored type values in the requested regions
facts: Relevant font sizes use the existing custom-property scale. No inline dynamic font size or arbitrary type utility is authored within method or file entries.
Body, paragraphs, buttons and summary use 1rem with unitless 1.5 leading; file entry h3 uses 1.5625rem, weight 500, tracking -0.02em.
Method heading uses 3.0517578125rem above 1199px and 2.44140625rem at or below 1199px, weight 700, tracking -0.035em.
Method lead uses 1.25rem; numeric unit and validation text use 0.8rem.
At a 16px root these are respectively 16/24px body, 25/37.5px h3, 48.828125/73.2421875px large method heading, 39.0625/58.59375px smaller method heading, 20/30px lead and 12.8/19.2px small text.
These are declared role values and arithmetic, not computed browser measurements or a judgment of hierarchy.

source_observations.topic: Text wrapping, overflow and interaction dimensions
facts: h1/h2 have overflow-wrap: break-word and text-wrap: balance. Method prose, summary text, file descriptions, import-review text and file errors have no authored overflow-wrap or word-break override.
Method content and import-review paragraphs are capped at 75ch; file descriptions have no ch-based cap. A maximum measure alone does not force long unbroken text to wrap.
Method summaries reserve an 18px non-shrinking icon plus a 10px gap. The code link reserves 18px and 16px icons plus two 8px gaps, leaving the remainder for its text.

The inspected regions have no local horizontal scrolling container, clipping rule, positioned overlay or z-index. Ordinary text can wrap at normal break opportunities; unbroken token behavior is not additionally guarded.
No rendered overflow, localized string, zoom, focus-ring or touch-target width measurement was performed. Declared minimum control heights do not certify all hit-target dimensions.
Both active fonts are registered with next/font/local and display: swap: Familjen Grotesk variable weight range 400-700 and Azeret Mono 100-900.
Method and file entry prose, headings and controls inherit the body family, with an authored sans-serif fallback. Numeric inputs also inherit the body family.
The scoped declared weights 400, 500 and 700 fall within the registered Familjen range.
Source registration alone does not prove loaded font assets, generated fallback metrics, absence of invisible text or absence of layout shift.

source_observations.topic: Arbitrary spacing and dynamic layout values beyond detector coverage
facts: Grid dimensions use --grid-columns, --gutter and --edge. Local file/method spacing is mostly literal CSS values rather than spacing custom properties.
Examples include 18px paragraph/title margins, 14px numeric bottom margin, 36px desktop file gaps, 28px mobile file gaps and 50/64/80/110px section padding.

Literal values are recorded as mechanical facts, not automatically classified as defects; the loaded design context describes a practical spacing vocabulary rather than a strict divisibility requirement.
The manual inspection includes the external stylesheet because the requested detector target is a TSX component whose layout/type declarations mostly live outside that target.

manual_risks.title: Pending model filename has no emergency line-break rule
evidence: src/lib/lab/import.ts:107 returns name: file.name without a display-length bound
src/components/lab/RouteLab.tsx:479-486 stores the returned asset as pendingModel
src/components/lab/RouteLab.tsx:1660-1667 renders pendingModel.name at the start of the import-review paragraph
src/app/globals.css:913-920 caps import-review prose at 75ch and assigns margins, with no word-break, overflow-wrap or overflow control
src/app/globals.css:139 applies overflow-wrap: break-word only to h1/h2, not this paragraph
manual_risks.trigger: Import a valid self-contained GLB/glTF with a long basename containing no spaces or hyphens, then inspect the pending import review before applying it.
manual_risks.implication: If the filename's unbroken rendered width exceeds the paragraph's used width, normal line breaking cannot wrap that token; text can extend beyond the paragraph and potentially the viewport.
manual_risks.suggested_parent_verification: At 320px or 390px CSS viewport width, use a valid model named with approximately 120 consecutive ASCII letters plus .glb. Compare the paragraph and document scrollWidth/clientWidth while the review is visible. Also inspect at increased text size.
manual_risks.limitation: No model was imported and no scroll dimensions were measured in this assessment. This is a source-backed conditional risk, not an observed browser failure.
